_comment: Preflight refusal rules. Each entry is a single regex matched against the user's raw query.
If any pattern matches, the orchestrator returns the refusal in refusal.md without spending tokens.
Keep patterns conservative — false positives block real users. Patterns are matched case-insensitively unless the entry sets 'ignore_case': false.
Categories are surface-stable; the chat service uses them only for logging.

patterns.pattern: \b(?:how (?:do i|to)|help me|teach me|explain how to|give me (?:steps|instructions))\b[^.]{0,80}\b(?:kill|murder|assassinate|stab|poison|bomb|shoot|attack|hurt|injure|maim|torture)\b[^.]{0,80}\b(?:him|her|them|someone|person|people|victim|wife|husband|child|kid|target)\b

\b(?:how (?:do i|to)|help me|teach me|show me how to|give me a template (?:to|for))\b[^.]{0,80}\b(?:forge|fake|fabricate|counterfeit|falsify)\b[^.]{0,80}\b(?:signature|court order|summons|judgment|affidavit|deed|id card|nic|passport|stamp|notary seal|police report)\b
